newsitem.title: USA: Grain loading accident shutters US Gulf elevator.
newsitem.headline: Grain loading accident shutters US Gulf elevator.

text.p: An accident that occured Thursday when a ship loading corn crashed into Zen-Noh Grain Corp grain elevator at the U.S. Gulf has shut down the facility, a company official said.
"The facility is temporarily closed until assessment of the damage is made," said Gary Wunsch, vice president with Zen-Noh Grain.

The accident occured at 1200 CST Thursday when a vessel loading 50,000 tonnes of corn destined for Saudi Arabia "made contact with the dock and structure of the Zen-Noh Grain Corp. terminal," Wunsch said.
No injuries occured as a result of the accident, Wunsch said.
Engineers are currently examining the damage, but their efforts were being hampered by heavy rainfall, Wunsch said.
The grain loading facility is located in Convent, La. at mile 164 on the Mississippi and has an annual handling capacity of 400 to 500 million bushels, Wunsch said.
